verdict.rationale: Jeeves Cash is described as multi-currency accounts with "up to 5% yield" and multi-currency balance storage. The global accounts page says you can manage cash in multiple currencies and "earn up to 5% annually*", which directly matches the story. The claims are marketing-level only: the asterisk and "up to" wording point to conditions that are never explained. missing for 10: which currencies (USD/EUR/GBP/CAD) actually earn yield and at what rates, eligibility terms behind the asterisk, how interest is accrued and paid, independent or hands-on corroboration.
